preconditions.description: Attacker must be a contract to perform a reentrant call.
Attacker contract must hold a non-zero balance of the MVK token to be eligible for rewards.
The contract's reward pool (_rewardPool) must have accumulated rewards since the attacker's last claim. This requires other users' transactions to have paid taxes.

exploit_hint: The 'claimReward' function is vulnerable to a classic reentrancy attack. It transfers BNB to the caller before updating the 'UserrewardPoolOnLastClaim' mapping. An attacker contract can call 'claimReward', and upon receiving the BNB in its fallback/receive function, it can call 'claimReward' again. This loop can be repeated to drain all available BNB from the contract's reward pool within a single transaction, as the check for eligibility does not account for the funds already sent in the same call.
